guardrails_added.lesson: The assistant booked an appointment before clarifying which Friday the user meant.
guardrails_added.guardrail: Before booking or changing an appointment, always ask the user to confirm the exact date when the requested date is ambiguous.

guardrails_added.lesson: The assistant acted on the request before the patient explicitly confirmed, causing unwanted bookings or cancellations.
guardrails_added.guardrail: Before executing any booking or cancellation action, always ask for and receive explicit patient confirmation.
